facts.fact: Google's Individuals plan for Antigravity costs $0/month and is listed as Generally Available.
facts.quote: Generally Available ## For Individuals $0/month Experience Antigravity without a subscription plan

facts.fact: The Individuals plan includes unlimited Tab completions and unlimited Command requests, with basic weekly rate limits.
facts.quote: Unlimited Tab completions Unlimited Command requests Basic weekly rate limits

facts.fact: Google's Business plan via Google Cloud has Standard/Plus plans starting at $30 USD per seat per month, available to eligible Gemini Enterprise customers.
facts.quote: plans starting at $30 USD per seat per month

facts.fact: Google states that existing Gemini Enterprise customers with an invoiced Cloud billing account can enable AI Developer tools for Antigravity through a setup guide.
facts.quote: Existing Gemini Enterprise customers with an invoiced Cloud billing account can visit the setup guide to enable AI Developer tools for Antigravity.
